SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2025-09' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as sept_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2025-10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as oct_sales
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) IN ('2025-09', '2025-10')

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as order_count,
  MIN(order_date) as earliest_date,
  MAX(order_date) as latest_date
FROM orders
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) as month,
  SUM(order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price) as sales
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) BETWEEN '2025-09' AND '2026-11'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date)
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2026-09' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as sept_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2026-10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as oct_sales
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) IN ('2026-09', '2026-10')

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) = '2026-10' THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) -

JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.parent_id = 1 THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped');
SELECT (209330.25 * 100.0 / 229474.7) AS percentage;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN orders.id END) AS valid_orders
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN order_items.qty * order_items.unit_price ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN orders.id END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id

SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS total_gross_profit
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE 
    o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    total_gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1;
